threads.body: [Testing] @copilot Please add declarative integration coverage for the SDK incubator `composite/development` -> `rule_based` sampler in both the Java agent and Spring Boot starter. Configure a `url.path` rule with `included: ["/actuator*"]` selecting `always_off`, followed by an unconditional `always_on` fallback. Verify that a matching span is not sampled and a nonmatching span is sampled. Exercise each distribution's actual declarative configuration path and bundled dependencies, rather than constructing the sampler directly. The current `always_off` tests do not cover the replacement recommended in this PR's migration guidance. The SDK already tests the sampler algorithm; the missing coverage here is configuration and packaging integration.

replies.body: Added both declarative integration tests and verified the Java agent and Spring Boot starter paths. The tests cover the `/actuator*` drop rule and always-on fallback. Commit: `9251b4ab`.
